YOUR PRACTICE SPACE

Play

Four independent games. Each has its own menu and settings.

Memorama

Match a hanzi card with its pinyin and English meaning.

One point per pair. A match keeps the turn; a miss or timeout passes to the next player. Restart keeps the same words; Restart all draws a fresh selection from the selected section. Maximum 100 cards.

Quick choice

Read the hanzi and choose its English meaning. Missed words return to your reviews.

Shorter sections use all available words.

Tone drill

Listen to a word, select a syllable, and identify its tone. Includes tones 1–4 and neutral tone.

Uses your device’s Mandarin voice. A pinyin hint is available during practice.

Initials & Finals — Pinyin Sound Challenge

Device Mandarin speech synthesis; phonetic accuracy is not guaranteed. Replay is always available. Expert is disabled until contrast recordings are validated. y/w are spelling categories; ui/iu/un represent uei/iou/uen. The special i sounds in zi/zhi are not tested as the high-front final i.
